title: Geologic map of the New Ellenton SW quadrangle, Aiken and Barnwell Counties, South Carolina
citation: Nystrom, P.G., Jr., 1997, Geologic map of the New Ellenton SW quadrangle, Aiken and Barnwell Counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-106, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Map sheet with a long OCR'd explanation in mixed columns; quotes are single-line excerpts. Symbols me, Qal 1, Qal 3, Qcb, Tp and Tal read from legend boxes on a page image; Tmb symbol not legible in the OCR and not recorded. OCR 'Fobacco' read as Tobacco. Qal 2 is known only in hole GMP-3 (not at the surface). GMP-3 interval depths are inferred from the stated thicknesses (25 ft Qal 1 over 15 ft Qal 2). Many map-face hole labels not recorded. Thirteen SC-relevant references kept. SUBSURFACE: GMP-3 organic bed age 33,900+370 B.P. (kept in the interval description); Qal 3 terrace base well above the active flood plain, no elevation printed.
